name: a01_sac_hybrid4_v13_obs3_lap_gasbursts
description: J6 (2026-10-04): continuation of j6-v11-obs3-lap (checkpoint 04849183, deterministic 25.14 s) with ONE change: exploration gas bursts (collection only). With probability 0.004 per step, hold gas without brake for 60-150 steps (ramp + flight ~90 steps; ~8% of laps fully covered); steering stays the policy's; replay stores the played action. Goal: let the critic see fast jumps and their landings (the policy brakes in the air on purpose; v12 showed it is not entropy noise). Same reward v3, discount, lr, entropy targets and observations; 1M replay kept. Evaluation is the frozen policy, without bursts.
